take: The bye is close to locked (96.4%), so your season is really two games: Week 16 and Week 17. Every move below is judged mostly on those two lineups, with Weeks 12 to 14 still counted so nobody who stinks until then sneaks in.
You win it all in 32.4% of sims (up from 28.6% last update). Your biggest threat is Chasing Brown Huzz at 22.1%.
Best trade they should actually accept: Rhamondre Stevenson for Kyle Monangai with Gomd Naber. Title odds +2.1 and their lineup moves -0.7 a week.
Backup plan: Jordan Addison + Kaleb Johnson for Adonai Mitchell (KoopKuppKlan), +2.3.
Swing big if they bite: Rhamondre Stevenson + KC Concepcion for Blake Corum (JELQING MY KING JD5) is worth +2.5, but it hurts their lineup so expect a no unless they're desperate.
Biggest risk: C.J. Stroud getting hurt costs you 23.1% in title odds. Make sure you have a real backup there.
